title: Engram turn_checkpoint answers a redaction refusal with generic storage_error, so TermAl cannot drop the refused report
outcome: A turn_checkpoint report that Engram's redactor refuses comes back with a distinct documented no-write code, which TermAl adds to its definitive-refusal list, so the report falls back instead of being kept for an exact replay that is refused again.
acceptance: Engram turn_checkpoint answers a redaction refusal with generic storage_error, so TermAl cannot drop the refused report is done
